name: Tenshi
source:
The young heir to the imperial throne and a descendant of an ancient line said to trace its origins back to the Gods. 
Despite his young age, he is wise, capable and takes his responsibilities very seriously. The people of the Japanese Empire have high hopes for his future rule.
